name: wp-agent-bridge-helper
description: Keep ChatGPT and Codex using a user's WP Agent Bridge GitHub Direct Runtime consistently, and prevent false tool-unavailable conclusions before an actual GitHub dependency attempt.

interface.shortDescription: Keep WordPress work routed through WP Agent Bridge and its required GitHub app.
interface.longDescription: Adds WP Agent Bridge workflow guidance for ChatGPT and Codex, including the required GitHub app, direct pending-command routing, result checks, and strict recovery rules that forbid claiming GitHub/WP Agent Bridge is unavailable before an actual dependency call or discovery attempt fails.
defaultPrompt: Use WP Agent Bridge for this WordPress task. Do not claim the GitHub dependency is unavailable without actually attempting the dependency/tool path.
Continue this WordPress task through WP Agent Bridge and execute the requested operation rather than stopping at a tool-availability explanation.
